tips: openssl x509 -in site.pem -noout -subject -issuer -dates : who, signed by whom, until when.

curl -k is never the fix. curl --cacert ca.pem is.
-checkend 2592000 : exit status 1 if it ends within 30 days. Let a program watch the dates.
